entity.name: Daniel Bannert
entity.description: I'm an independent software developer from Germany. I maintain the visulima monorepo of Node.js and TypeScript libraries, the packem bundler and the anolilab semantic-release tooling for monorepos. Funding pays for the maintenance work these projects need and that nobody else pays for: security fixes, dependency and Node.js updates, issue triage, releases and documentation.

projects.name: Visulima
projects.description: Visulima is a monorepo of 49 MIT-licensed Node.js and TypeScript libraries, published on npm under @visulima. It covers terminal output (boxen, colorize, pail, spinner, progress-bar), file system helpers (fs, path, find-cache-dir), error handling and debugging (error, error-handler, source-map, vite-overlay), data handling (humanizer, bytes, redact, yaml, deep-clone) and API helpers (health-check, pagination). Many other packages and CLIs depend on these libraries, so they need steady security and compatibility work.

plans.name: Yearly maintenance
plans.description: Pays for ongoing maintenance: security fixes, dependency and Node.js updates, issue and pull request triage, releases and documentation.
